name: 55445 · Brooklyn Park, MN
findings: ZIP 55445 (Brooklyn Park) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55445 (Brooklyn Park) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55445 (Brooklyn Park) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 8% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
